svg.text: ALL FOOTINGS SHALL BE CENTERED UNDER COLUMNS AND WALLS.
TOP OF ALL FOOTINGS SHALL BE A MINIMUM OF 6" BELOW TOP OF FINISHED FLOOR SLAB
BARRIER BENEATH FLOOR SLABS SHALL BE 6 MIL VISQUEEN OR EQUAL.
REINFORCING WHERE SHOWN ON DRAWINGS. PLACE MESH IN CENTER OF SLAB. VAPOR
UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. LAP MESH 8" AT EDGES AND ENDS AND PROVIDE ADDITIONAL
ALL SLABS ON GRADE SHALL BE 4" THICK AND BE REINFORCED WITH 6x6 10/10 W.W.M,
GRND GROUND GYP GYPSUM GYP BD GYPSUM BOARD
PHW HOT WATER HWH HOT WATER HEATER
OUS MT MOUNT, MOUNTED MTL MATERIAL
N NORTH NO NUMBER NTS NOT TO SCALE
SQUARE SST STAINLESS STEEL STL STEEL STRUCT STRUCTURAL
DO NOT SCALE DRAWINGS USE FIGURED DIMENSIONS ONLY.
ACH TRUSS WITH HURRICANE CLIPS AS SPECIFIED AND DETAILED.
